task.description: Micro-amendment of the requirements after the code design of REQ-069 (WF-01 section "Micro-amendment after the code design"). Read decisions/0085 (ORCH answers O1-O4) and docs/design/REQ-069-tenant-look-format.md (sections that describe O1-O4 and the measured contrast). Edit ONLY: (1) REQ-069 criterion 3 and the description where they speak of the staff name and of the option `object`: the staff name is letters, combining marks, digits, space, hyphen, apostrophe and dot, 1-30 characters, anything else is E_FIELD, so that the criterion's error for `url(http://x)` as a staff name holds; `object` is accepted on options of single and multiple questions only (a number question has no options). Do not weaken any criterion: only make the text agree with what can be met; give result.before_copy (tag base/MA069-20261026-01 version of every edited line) and result.changes (was -> became). Nothing else in docs/requirements.yaml changes (hash of the rest equal before and after). No code. No machine paths or project names in your handoff text (say "the traces list"). Close your handoff.

issues.text: The task and the design call the criterion with «url(http://x)» and 'любого из трёх типов' criterion 3. In the file it is criterion 4 (Предметы офиса); criterion 3 is Цвета. I amended the criterion by its text, not by the number: criterion 4 (staff name, object) and criterion 3 (the colour «#e0731f» listed as 'без ошибки', which cannot hold after item 4 of decisions/0085). The numbering inside the file is unchanged.

Row (12) of the page-test table (QS-12) acts now (decisions/0085 item 5). Later blocks that list row (12) or QS-12 among the rows they touch or restate it (REQ-071, REQ-074, REQ-075, REQ-080, REQ-086, REQ-087; found by grep -n '(12)\|QS-12' over docs/requirements.yaml after the REQ-069 block) still read true: they now find the walk over picker-*.js already in place. I did not edit them (outside the named scope, anti-pattern AP-019). REQ-VALIDATOR or ORCH may decide whether their wording 'which requirement reddens row (12) first' (REQ-071) needs a later touch.

Final colour values for the two corrected demo accents are not written: the design gives boundary colours of the sheets (F10: #c67d42 light, #76691d dark), not the nearest colours to #e0731f and #5b3fd6; the rule and the check are written. #c67d42 appears only as a test literal of REQ-069 criterion 3.
